open_points.text: `trial_execution_id` M07, `binding_id` M11, `run_id` M19, `approval_id` M24 and `grant_id` M25 are minted at random by the kernel; one that already exists is minted again.
open_points.question: Which module owns random identifier generation, the entropy source, collision detection and retry for these five record types?
options: `store` atomically mints and collision-checks every random identifier
Each record-owning module generates identifiers and retries after `store` reports a collision
A separate lower-level identity capability generates identifiers while `store` checks uniqueness
open_points.default_guess: Have `store` atomically mint and collision-check every random identifier because uniqueness is determined against its records.
